title: Paul Smith remote views the USS Stark attack

tellings.quote: I started describing this vessel, which reminded me of an American destroyer.

plain: Paul Smith, who worked in a US government psychic spy programme, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a session of remote viewing, the claimed skill of describing distant places and events using only the mind. He says that in 1987 he started describing a vessel that reminded him of an American destroyer, which he links to the attack on the USS Stark, a US Navy ship hit in the Persian Gulf during the Iran-Iraq War. He mentions a colleague, Skip Atwater, and a Washington Post report. If true, it would mean he sensed a real attack from afar.
